items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Frank Rosolino and Conte Condoli, were they playing out there?

ctx.x: No. So I'd go out there and sit in. Howard would be glad to see me come, and let me sit in in his place, you know, and he'd get out and mingle with the audience, the public, you know. And at that time they had Bob Cooper and Stanley --
Frank Rosolino and Conte Condoli, were they playing out there?
No, they weren't there then. Was it Williamson?
